title: 3 Inch Cabinet Pull Solid Brass | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Cabinet Hardware Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Bring a clean, coordinated look to bathroom cabinets and drawers while improving everyday grip in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This 3 inch cabinet pull (also called a cabinet handle or drawer pull) is part of a cabinet hardware collection suited to transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Durable build: solid brass construction
- Ready to install: mounting hardware included
- Finish flexibility: offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 x 1.6 x 3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 3 x 3 x 3 in.
- Shipping weight: 1 lb.
- Assembly: assembled in the USA
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
